Committee: Constitution, Campaigns and Elections
Sponsor: Coleman
Analyst: Vee Mosely
Date: 02/14/2022
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 319 as introduced will increase the proclamation expenses of the Governor, paid from the State General Fund, by an estimated $100,000 for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2023, by proposing an amendment to the Constitution of Alabama of 1901.
Bob Fincher, Chair
Constitution, Campaigns and Elections
